# RoundsVaultInput
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/rounds-vault/RoundsVaultInput.sol)

**Inherits:**
[RoundsVaultBase](./rounds-vault-base.md), [IRoundsVaultInput](../../interfaces/rounds-vault/i-rounds-vault-input.md), [IRoundsVaultInputEvents](../../interfaces/rounds-vault/i-rounds-vault-input-events.md)

**Title:**
RoundsVaultInput

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Input flavor of `RoundsVaultBase`. Users deposit the target vault's underlying asset
(e.g. USDC) and receive ERC-1155 receipts for the current round. When the keeper closes and
settles the round, the frozen underlying is deposited into the target vault and the target
vault's shares are credited as the round's exchange asset. Holders of past-round receipts can
then redeem them for shares at the round's snapshotted rate.


## Functions
### constructor

CONSTRUCTOR

Wires the Input-flavor rounds-vault to its target ERC-4626 vault and the protocol
access manager.

For an Input vault the deposit asset is the target vault's underlying asset; the exchange
asset (returned by `redeemExchangeAsset`) is the target vault itself (its shares).


```solidity
constructor(
    address targetVault,
    address accessManager,
    string memory receiptsURI
)
    RoundsVaultBase(targetVault, BaseVaultType.Input, accessManager, receiptsURI);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetVault`|`address`|The target ERC-4626 vault this Input vault wraps; settlement deposits into this vault each round.|
|`accessManager`|`address`|The `ProtocolAccessManagerV2` instance that gates keeper and governor entry points (e.g. only the keeper may call `nextRound`).|
|`receiptsURI`|`string`|The ERC-1155 metadata URI for round receipts minted on deposit.|


### _operate

INTERNAL FUNCTIONS

Deposits the round's frozen underlying balance into the target vault and returns the
amount of target-vault shares received. The shares stay in this contract and back
`redeemExchangeAsset` payouts for the round.


```solidity
function _operate(uint256 assets, uint256 roundId) internal override returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`||
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The id of the round being settled|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|outputAmount The exact amount the target vault returned after the settlement trade|


### _getFallbackExchangeRate

Returns the exchange rate used when a round had no deposits at settlement time.

Derives the rate from the target vault's `previewDeposit` for one full unit of the
deposit asset, so empty rounds still snapshot a sensible price aligned with what a
synchronous deposit would have produced at settlement time.


```solidity
function _getFallbackExchangeRate() internal view override returns (Price memory);
```
